    read input of RHtestsV4

    Read.Rd

    Remove NA values and flag y[t] as 0 when it has not corresponding y[t+1] values.

    Read(InSeries, MissingValueCode = "-999.99", plev = 0.95)

    Arguments

    InSeries

    file path or data frame of the input series

    MissingValueCode

    string, missing value code

    plev

    plev is the nominal level of confidence; (1 - plev) is the nominal level of significance, choose one of the following 6 plev values: 0.75, 0.80, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99, 0.9999

    Value

    An S7 RHState object containing the series, seasonal cycle and critical values. Nt is 1, 12 or 365 for annual, monthly or daily series, respectively.

    Examples

    infile = system.file("extdata/Example1.dat", package = "RHtests")
Read(infile, "-999.99")
#> <RHtests::RHState>
